input.query: SELECT CASE WHEN event_date < DATE '2025-11-10' THEN 'baseline' ELSE 'recent' END period, app_version, count(*) attempts, avg(is_kyc_approved::INT) approval_rate, avg((reject_reason='doc_unreadable')::INT) unreadable_rate FROM fct_kyc_attempts WHERE event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' AND platform='android' AND doc_type='national_id' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
